name: CreateDocParserJob

parameters.help_en: The region ID
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The HTTP or HTTPS URL of the file to be parsed.
The SDKs for various programming languages additionally provide a `CreateDocParserJobAdvance` method that supports passing a local file stream directly (such as Java InputStream), without the need to upload the file to Object Storage Service (OSS) in advance and construct a FileUrl. When using the Advance method, replace the `FileUrl` parameter (URL string) with the `FileUrlObject` parameter (file stream). All other request parameters remain unchanged. The SDK automatically performs the following operations:
Obtains temporary OSS upload credentials.
Uploads the file stream directly to OSS.
Calls the CreateDocParserJob operation with the generated OSS URL
parameters.help_zh:
待解析文件的HTTP或HTTPS URL地址。
各语言SDK额外提供了`CreateDocParserJobAdvance`方法，支持直接传入本地文件流（如Java的InputStream），无需预先将文件上传到OSS并构造FileUrl。使用Advance方法时，用`FileUrlObject`参数（文件流）替代`FileUrl`参数（URL字符串），其余请求参数保持不变。SDK内部自动完成以下操作：
获取OSS临时上传凭证。
将文件流直传到OSS。
使用生成的OSS URL调用CreateDocParserJob接口
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.help_en: The file name, which must include the file name extension
parameters.help_zh: 文件名称，需包含文件扩展名
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en:
The format of the input file. Valid values:

pdf: PDF file.

docx: Word file in .docx format.

doc: Word file in .doc format.

pptx: PPT file in .pptx format.

ppt: PPT file in .ppt format.

txt: Plain text file.

md: Markdown file.

png: PNG image.

jpg: JPG image.

jpeg: JPEG image
parameters.help_zh:
输入文件的格式。取值：

pdf：PDF文件。

docx：Word文件（docx格式）。

doc：Word文件（doc格式）。

pptx：PPT文件（pptx格式）。

ppt：PPT文件（ppt格式）。

txt：纯文本文件。

md：Markdown文件。

png：PNG图片。

jpg：JPG图片。

jpeg：JPEG图片
parameters.name: file_format

parameters.help_en:
The output format of the parsing result. Valid values:

markdown: Markdown format
parameters.help_zh:
解析结果的输出格式。取值：

markdown：Markdown格式
parameters.name: output_format

parameters.help_en: The OSS file URL
parameters.help_zh: oss文件url
parameters.name: oss_file_url

parameters.help_en: The image carrier mode. Valid values: ignore, base64, placeholder, and oss (default, returns image links in the body)
parameters.help_zh: 图片载体方式：ignore / base64 / placeholder / oss（默认，正文中返回图片链接）
parameters.name: image_mode

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to generate image understanding text. Valid values: full (default) and none
parameters.help_zh: 是否生成图片理解文本：full（默认）/ none
parameters.name: image_understanding

parameters.help_en: The table format. Valid values: html and markdown (default)
parameters.help_zh: 表格格式：html / markdown（默认）
parameters.name: table_format

parameters.help_en: The result return method. Valid values: content (default, Markdown body) and url (temporary OSS download URL)
parameters.help_zh: Result 返回方式：content（默认，Markdown 正文）/ url（临时 OSS 下载地址）
parameters.name: result_type

parameters.help_en: The agent name
parameters.help_zh: 代理名称
parameters.name: agent_name

parameters.help_en: The response mode. Valid values: async (default, returns only JobId for the caller to poll) and sync (returns the parsing result synchronously within the same request. See the response description below)
parameters.help_zh: 响应模式：async（默认，仅返回 JobId，由调用方轮询）/ sync（同一请求内同步返回解析结果，见下方响应说明）
parameters.name: response_mode

parameters.help_en: The chunking strategy. This parameter takes effect only for videos. Valid values: scene (default, chunks by scene) and interval (chunks at fixed intervals)
parameters.help_zh: 仅视频生效。切分策略：scene（默认，按场景切分）/ interval（按固定间隔切分）
parameters.name: media_chunk_strategy

parameters.help_en: The media chunk interval in seconds. This parameter takes effect only for videos. Specifies the duration in seconds for each segment under the interval strategy. Valid values: 5 to 600
parameters.help_zh: 媒体分块时间间隔（秒），仅视频生效。interval 策略下每段时长（秒），范围 [5, 600]
parameters.name: media_chunk_interval_seconds

parameters.help_en: The minimum media frame budget. This parameter takes effect only for videos. Specifies the lower limit of the frame budget. Valid values: 1 to 600. If the upper limit is also set, the lower limit must not exceed the upper limit
parameters.help_zh: 媒体最小帧预算，仅视频生效。帧预算下限，范围 [1, 600]；若同时设置上限，下限不得大于上限
parameters.name: media_min_frame_budget

parameters.help_en: The number of frames extracted per minute. This parameter takes effect only for videos. Valid values: 0 to 30. A value of 0 disables the dynamic frame budget
parameters.help_zh: 仅视频生效。每分钟抽帧数量，范围 [0, 30]；0 表示关闭动态帧预算
parameters.name: media_frames_per_minute

parameters.help_en: The maximum media frame budget. This parameter takes effect only for videos. Specifies the upper limit of the frame budget. Valid values: 1 to 600. If the lower limit is also set, the lower limit must not exceed the upper limit
parameters.help_zh: 仅视频生效。帧预算下限，范围 [1, 600]；若同时设置上限，下限不得大于上限
parameters.name: media_max_frame_budget

parameters.help_en: The chunk window length in seconds. This parameter takes effect only for audio-only files. Valid values: 10 to 600. Passing this parameter for a video request returns an InvalidParameter error
parameters.help_zh: 仅纯音频生效。chunk 窗口长度（秒），范围 [10, 600]；视频请求传入会返回 InvalidParameter
parameters.name: audio_window_seconds

parameters.help_en: The Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) language hint. Valid values: auto (default), zh, and en. When set to auto, the language field in the result is empty
parameters.help_zh: ASR 语种提示：auto（默认）/ zh / en。auto 时结果中的 language 字段为空
parameters.name: asr_language

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to output key frame images to OSS. This parameter takes effect only for videos. Default value: true. The media references in the result use the oss:// protocol address, which requires the caller to have OSS permissions to read
parameters.help_zh: 仅视频生效。是否输出关键帧原图到 OSS，默认 true。结果中的媒体引用为 oss:// 协议地址，需调用方凭 OSS 权限读取
parameters.name: frame_output

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to output segmented audio clips to OSS. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否输出分段音频片段到 OSS，默认 true
parameters.name: audio_clip_output

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to generate a one-sentence summary for each segment. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否为每个分段生成一句话总结，默认 true
parameters.name: chunk_summary

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to generate an overall summary. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否生成全片概要，默认 true
parameters.name: global_summary

parameters.help_en: The parsing scene. This parameter takes effect only for document and image parsing. Valid values: general (default) and formula_ocr (full-page OCR with formulas output in LaTeX)
parameters.help_zh: 解析场景：general（默认）/ formula_ocr（整页 OCR，公式输出 LaTeX）。仅文档和图片解析生效
parameters.name: parse_scene

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
